title: Lift a rank-2 ADD against a constant to rank 3 (RESHAPE -> ADD -> RESHAPE) for the Metal accelerator
expected_effect: the rank-2 ADD against a constant becomes RESHAPE -> ADD(rank 3, [1,N,C]) -> RESHAPE; the Metal accelerator computes the rank-3 form bit-exact where it silently miscomputed the rank-2 form (measured rel 1.25 -> 1.9e-6 on a 27-block ViT encoder), so the `incorrect` finding is removed and the three replacement nodes delegate

evidence.source_model: North-Micro-Vision-Instruct vision encoder (Qwen3-VL-structure ViT) + 4 synthetic micro-graphs via tools/backend_diff, BACKEND_DIFF_FLOAT_FILL=1; data/matrix/gpu_metal_mac__2.1.6.json ADD row
evidence.litert_version: ai-edge-litert 2.1.6 CompiledModel Metal (precision 2 and 1 both reproduce)

notes: Promoted 2026-08-19 on the owner's blanket delegation for this lane ("全部お任せします") — the first rule that uses the v1.1 engine additions (derived `unsqueeze0:` intermediate shapes, engine-synthesized RESHAPE shape constants, `operand_b=constant` match via classify.operand_meta). Semantics: RESHAPE is a pure view; ADD broadcasting is unchanged because both operands gain the same leading unit axis; the fixture verification is bit-exact (max_abs_diff 0.0). Scope: ADD only, operand_b constant, static shapes; the measured defect was observed for ADD with a rank-2 constant — the same-shape MUL/SUB forms were not measured and are deliberately NOT matched. Why rank 3 and not 4: rank 3 is the smallest form measured correct, and keeps the fix a view. Counterpart facts: the rank-2 form is fine on CPU/XNNPACK (this is a Metal-accelerator defect, backend row carries it); applying the rule on a backend without the row is harmless (views) but pointless.
